approaches.name: Clean, then reverse
approaches.intuition: Build the cleaned string of lower-case letters and digits and compare it with its reverse.
steps: Keep only letters and digits, lower-cased

approaches.name: Two pointers on the original
approaches.intuition: Walk inwards from both ends and skip the characters that do not count, so no extra string is built.
steps: Skip non-alphanumeric characters at each end
pitfalls: An empty cleaned string counts as a palindrome.
Index checks while skipping: do not run past the other pointer.

talkTrackMd: Mention both versions and the space difference. For the pointer version, state the loop invariant: everything outside `[l, r]` has already matched.
